# BARBELL — YOUR WORKOUT TRACKER

Barbell is an open-source workout tracker derived from the openGym project. Its code remains under GNU AGPL v3. The Barbell repository is https://github.com/mohammedsunainali/barbell .

## Documentation
- Overview, verified features, and source-build quick start: https://github.com/mohammedsunainali/barbell/blob/main/README.md
- Self-hosting: https://github.com/mohammedsunainali/barbell/blob/main/docs/SELF_HOSTING.md
- AI Coach: https://github.com/mohammedsunainali/barbell/blob/main/docs/AI_COACH.md
- HTTP API: https://github.com/mohammedsunainali/barbell/blob/main/api/openapi.yaml
- License and media provenance: https://github.com/mohammedsunainali/barbell/blob/main/NOTICE.md

There is no verified Barbell production domain, signed APK, or store listing. Upstream downloads are not Barbell releases.
